name: projection-pill
title: ProjectionPill
description: Dashed muted pill that marks a screen or a block as a projection ("Projection · v2 module"): a proposed feature, not available today. Used on Agent, AgentTestRun, Import and Sources.

a11y.pattern: A plain <span> with visible text; the title attribute only adds detail
aria: The visible words carry the meaning ("Projection · v2 module"), never the dashed border alone
The title is a supplementary tooltip: it is not keyboard reachable, so do not put required information only there
a11y.notes: Muted 11px mono text keeps 4.5:1 on the canvas, surface and page backgrounds in both themes. Static item: not focusable.
